China’s military purge just spawned a bizarre new twist: a viral “open letter” supposedly written by purged General Zhang Youxia. It paints him as an anti-Xi hero who wanted democracy and peace. There’s just one problem—it’s almost certainly fake. Here’s why this letter smells like disinformation, and who benefits from it.
